item.title: AgentDeck 1.22.1
item.description: Panel tabs collapse to icons-only when the panel is too narrow to fit every label, and show labels again when there's room. Hover any icon for its name.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.22.0
item.description: New Git panel (next to Watcher), wired to the tab's Home folder: branch and ahead/behind status, clean/dirty state, commit history you can expand for the full message and diffstat, your uncommitted changes colour-coded, and open pull requests and issues when the GitHub CLI (gh) is installed. Quick links to open the repo on GitHub or reveal it in Finder.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.21.2
item.description: Reminders: set a Remind Me time on any To Do task (This evening / Tomorrow 9am presets or a full date-and-time picker) that fires through Microsoft To Do and Outlook, with a bell and a reminder chip on each task. Plus a redesigned task bar: one clean composer with a send button and Important / Due / Remind pills that light up when set.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.21.1
item.description: Microsoft To Do: no more duplicate local copy when adding a task; tasks now carry importance (star) and a due date you can set from a calendar, with overdue/today highlighting; rename a task by double-clicking it; the list auto-refreshes on focus plus a background poll so changes from the website or another device appear on their own.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.21.0
item.description: Connect the Tasks panel to Microsoft To Do: a cloud button signs you in (device-code, no password typed into AgentDeck), shows your list's open tasks, ticks them complete, and adds new ones to To Do. Stays signed in across launches. Client ID / Tenant configurable in Settings → Integrations.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.20.1
item.description: Governor: briefing a tab with no Home folder now warns and lets you set one first, instead of quietly launching the workers in your default directory. A tab is a project; its workers should start in it.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.20.0
item.description: The Governor: brief a tab's governor with a task and it plans the work into up to four focused workers, dispatches them onto the tab, tracks them, collects their results and synthesises a single answer. Suggest shows the plan to approve; Auto runs it. Plus a stall fix: non-Claude agents that finish without a prompt-style last line now settle to done, so the watcher and governor stop hanging.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.19.1
item.description: Watcher panel gains a live team tree: spawned agents were flat tiles with no lineage, so a fanned-out team was unreadable. The Watcher tab now shows each primary with its team nested by depth — every node's state, role, activity and status, click any to jump to its tile.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.19.0
item.description: The watcher becomes a real orchestrator: recursive fan-out (a spawned agent can spawn its own specialists, up to 4 deep / 12 per team, findings aggregating back up), every spawned agent briefed with the full protocol, a structured POST /orchestrate channel alongside the terminal convention, per-task model routing, and spawned agents that auto-close when done. Plus a Clear Log button. Permission and destructive prompts always escalate to you at any depth.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.18.0
item.description: Terminals adopt the refresh palette (no more blue-black inside near-black chrome). Per-agent instruction files: a tab's briefing goes to the file its own agents read (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md), only in the tab's own home, with an overlapping-home warning. The watcher can now pick the best installed agent for a consult task.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.17.1
item.description: Watcher reliability: terminal output is cleaned before the watcher reads it, a heartbeat re-evaluates stuck sessions, drafts and escalations park explicitly, and arming the watcher writes a supervision contract into the tab home's CLAUDE.md (removed on disarm) so agents know the rules and can request experts with WATCHER: consult.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.17.0
item.description: The redesign: achromatic chrome where hue only ever means agent state, the NEEDS YOU attention rail, decluttered tile headers with an Assist menu, Watcher mission control in the right panel, tab colours as slim left rules, and pill-style status bar. Every feature and shortcut unchanged.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.16.0
item.description: The Watcher: enable it on a tab and agent turns are triaged automatically — simple questions answered so agents stop hanging, work fanned out to a configurable expert roster (spawned as real agent tiles, with two-way follow-up dialogue relayed between agents), anything destructive escalated to you. Full audit in the new Watcher Log and watcher-audit.jsonl. Uses your Anthropic key; Suggest mode by default.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.15.3
item.description: Hovering over an agent no longer moves the TUI input cursor (keystrokes stopped landing mid-sentence), and collapsed tab groups can rename the selected tab via double-click or right-click → Rename.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.15.2
item.description: Agent launches no longer pollute your shell history: the auto-typed launch command is excluded from zsh/bash/fish history files. Toggle in Settings → Interface, on by default.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.15.1
item.description: Updater validation release — no functional changes. Confirms the full Sparkle cycle: prompt, download, install, relaunch.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.15.0
item.description: Live status bar along the bottom of the window: realtime session counts by state (click the amber waiting cell to jump to the next agent needing input), active tab + home folder, focused session git status, relay/remote counts, hook port and version.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.14.1
item.description: Collapsed tab groups keep the home-folder indicator: the parent chip shows the house glyph for the member it displays, and the member menu marks homed tabs.

item.title: AgentDeck 1.14.0
item.description: AgentDeck now updates itself via Sparkle: automatic background checks plus AgentDeck → Check for Updates…. Updates are EdDSA-signed and notarized end to end. This is the last version you need to download by hand.
